Timecode

Definition

Timecode is a sequence of coded time values used to identify frames and synchronize picture, sound and metadata. In a controlled workflow, its owner, version and acceptance evidence should be recorded.

Why it matters

This concept helps production teams align media decisions, handoffs and verification without relying on unstated assumptions.
